source: `scripts/dump-entries.ts --watch 300` on a live room (cwd web-client), frames as the machine pushed them. The FIRST capture in this corpus carrying `evt` frames: 12 `evt:panel` envelopes. The producer of the panel/face content is the extension's own e2e harness (`/unbien test all`, extension/src/commands/test_scenarios.ts), which EMITS the underlying bus events so the REAL `panel_bridge` builds the frames — the wire shape is the shipped code path, the content is canned. The turns around it (bash/read/edit/write, an aborted turn, two errored turns) are real turns driven by hand.
scrub: Free text (panel titles, tool args, messages, partial output) → «length»; ids, keys, `status`, `kind`, `deps`, `notify_type`, `stopReason`, `mimeType`, tool names and durations kept verbatim — they are the contract. The 2060 `message_update` delta frames were dropped: streaming is pinned by 015, and this scenario asks about panels, asks and result faces.
description: The panel and notice planes, plus the tool-face spread the harness emits. Pins: (a) `evt:panel` envelopes carry `panel_update {key, title, icon, data:{items:[…]}}` — `key:"subagents"` (title Agents, icon person.2) and `key:"plan"` (icon checklist) — arriving as repeated full snapshots (coalesced per source per 60 ms tick), NOT as deltas, so a fold must replace a source's whole set rather than merge per item; (b) the same `subagents` source is re-sent many times with an unchanged payload — a client that appends on every frame grows the panel forever; (c) `extension_ui_request {method:"notify", notify_type:"info"}` rides the rpc plane, and un-bien's own bookkeeping must not become a transcript row here (it is a toast); (d) the tool names the harness exercises — `subagent`, `codemode`, `mcp`, `render_svg`, `web_fetch`, `grep`, `find`, `write`, `edit`, `read`, `bash` — each resolve to their declared FACE on the LIVE plane, where the result is `{content, details}` (`partialResult` is `{content:[…], details:{}}`, never a string); (e) `stopReason` values seen in one window: `stop`, `pending`, `aborted` (3), `error` (2) — the first `aborted` turns this corpus has ever contained; (f) ZERO frames carried `aux`, including the two `edit` tool calls — see note.
note: The `aux` sidecar (diff hunks) appeared in NONE of the 2272 live frames, `edit` calls included, so on the live plane a card's hunks are not delivered alongside its result frame. Whether they ride only the durable/replay plane or only reach the app under a capability this client does not advertise is untested here — 012 pins `hunks` on the replay side. Recorded as a gap rather than a claim.
